items.title: Ukraine warns of interceptor missile shortage as 18 killed in Kyiv region
items.description: President Zelensky says Sunday's "massive Russian attack" on Kyiv consisted of 68 missiles and 351 strike drones.

items.title: 'I ate ketchup and cheese,' says Venezuelan girl trapped under quake rubble for 32 hours
items.description: Fabiana was trapped in the rubble of a 10-storey residential building after two earthquakes rocked Venezuela in June.

items.title: Australian PM apologises for 'inappropriate' comments about Kylie Minogue
items.description: Albanese has apologised 'unequivocally' after his remarks prompted a backlash.

items.title: Marine Le Pen appeal verdict: Why this moment matters for France
items.description: The leader of France's National Rally leads the opinion polls ahead of the 2027 presidential election and will now find out if she can stand.

items.title: A global hub for fake luxury goods, Vietnam cracks down on its black market
items.description: The Trump administration wants Vietnam to stamp out its booming counterfeit industry. Locals are divided.

items.title: Super Typhoon Bavi makes landfall on US Pacific islands with huge wind gusts
items.description: The storm, with winds of nearly 290km/h (180mph) and gusts of 350km/h, is lashing the island of Rota.

items.title: Australia space agency has found 'likely source' of mystery space balls
items.description: The agency says that they "appear to be pressure vessels from a space launch vehicle".

items.title: 'Definitely felt a big bang': Delta plane hit by firework while landing in Chicago
items.description: The plane had 52 passengers and six crew onboard. No injuries were reported.

items.title: The African fishermen who blame Chinese trawlers for their woes
items.description: Fishing crews in Sierra Leone say large Chinese ships are illegally hoovering up stocks.

items.title: Bangladesh courts China even as ties with India improve
items.description: Relations between Dhaka and Delhi, that turned frosty under the interim government, are on the mend.

items.title: Thousands welcome home Cape Verde footballers after stunning World Cup run
items.description: Tens of thousands of fans formed an ocean of blue outside the airport in capital city, Praia.

items.title: Nigeria says two nationals killed in South Africa amid rise of anti-migrant attacks
items.description: Nigeria's government said one of its nationals was reportedly killed by police officers "using gruesome interrogation techniques".

claude-code.name: claude-memory-kit
claude-code.description: Persistent per-project memory for Claude Code & Kiro — plain markdown committed with your code, captured prompt-free, auto-injected at session start, recalled by meaning (local semantic search, zero API). Cross-project persona, cited recall, searchable session history.

claude-code.name: enji-guard-cli
claude-code.description: CLI/MCP agent surface for Enji Guard

claude-code.name: metatron
claude-code.description: Metatron is a self-hosted system that captures a codebase's real implementation decisions — preferred patterns, rejected approaches, edge cases, internal conventions — as structured priors, and serves them to coding agents over MCP (Model Context Protocol). The goal: an agent writes code like a senior engineer who already knows the codebase

claude-code.name: slides_maker
claude-code.description: Turn papers, code, and docs into presentation-ready, natively editable PPTX in Codex / Claude Code. Native charts and equations, speaker notes, click-build animations, and an independent critic review before delivery.

claude-code.name: keel
claude-code.description: Decisions, not standards. Keel is a Claude Code plugin for product builders who direct AI rather than type code — it sits at decision moments (should we build this, which shape, what breaks if we're wrong, what does wrong cost), not at code-style moments.
